title: Persist a versioned provider-consumer contract definition
preconditions: Use the CLI plan test fixture with provider cli and consumer docs work items in the same feature.

steps.action: Run plan add-contract for cli-docs revision cli-docs-r1, kind handoff, provider cli, consumer docs, statement "Publish stable help", acceptance "Every command has deterministic help" and a unique request-id.
steps.expected_result: The public writer succeeds and returns one initial event.

steps.action: Inspect the stored definition through an available public contract read projection.
steps.expected_result: The exact revision identity, provider, consumer, kind, statement and acceptance checks are retrievable unchanged.

expected_result: The agreed seam has a versioned definition with concrete acceptance checks.
